about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass at Dawn” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May our gifts, we beseech Thee, O Lord, prove worthy of the mysteries of this day’s Nativity and ever pour forth peace upon us; that as He Who was born man shone forth also as God, so this earthly substance may bestow upon us that which is divine. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.

seg.nr: Then commemoration is made of Saint Anastasia, Martyr.

seg.tr: Graciously accept, we beseech Thee, O Lord, the gifts offered, and through the aiding merits of blessed Anastasia, Thy Martyr, grant that they may avail unto our salvation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
